tooltips.accumulable: Reward multiplier. When it is 2 or more and the promotion has a single range, the reward is granted up to ''accumulable'' times depending on how many times the minimum condition is met (e.g., if it is 3 and the minimum condition is 1, the customer can get up to 3 rewards by buying 3 qualifying units).
tooltips.maxUsagePerOrder: Maximum number of times the customer can apply this promotion in a single order. Leave it empty for no limit.
tooltips.maxUsagePerClient: Maximum number of times the customer can use this promotion in total (all time). Leave it empty for no limit.
tooltips.maxUsagePerClientPerMonth: Maximum redemptions per customer in the current month. Empty or 0 = no monthly limit.
tooltips.maxGlobalUsage: Maximum total redemptions across all customers in the project. Leave it empty for no overall limit.
tooltips.businessUnit: Restricts the promotion to a single business unit (e.g., ''Institucional'', ''Retail''). If empty, it applies to all business units in the project. It is only shown to customers whose BU in client_marketplace matches.
tooltips.isFlex: ''Flex'' promotion: the customer gets the reward automatically, without choosing among options A/B/C. When off, the customer must pick an option.
tooltips.takeFirstEligibleRangeDiscount: When on, ONLY the first eligible range of the applied discount is used. By default (off), the best available range is applied.
tooltips.applyCrossSelling: When on (default), the promotion allows cross-selling (secondary discounts / order discounts). When off, cross-selling is disabled and the secondary discounts array is sent empty when calculating the package discount.
tooltips.isPromotionCompatibleWithAllNegotiations: Lets this promotion stack with the customer's negotiated prices. When off, the promotion does NOT apply if the customer has active negotiations.
